notes.title: Ponpu releasing November 5
notes.content:
[h1]Bombs on! [/h1]

We're super hyped to share that Ponpu will release in just 1 month!

Featuring an epic campaign as well as frantic online/offline battles with up to 4 murderous ducks! 

[h2]November 5![/h2]

Check out the new trailer here:

notes.title: Gameplay Contest: Winner announcement!
notes.content:
The contest is now finally over and the 5 winners are now selected.

The community have selected:
[h2]Story Mode![/h2]
[url=http://www.playponpu.com/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37336806/0aef5152793d9627ba3b9aa0083787e023934fdb.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]The 5 winners[/h2]
Out of all people who voted in this contest we randomly selected 5 winners who will all receive a Ponpu Gamekey that will allow them to activate Ponpu in their game library here on Steam, which will give the player access to the game on launch. In a chronological order in which the players voted, we randomly generated a number corresponding to each participant from 1-12. Here are the winners and their number.

Voter number and name:
2. Burgurdur
11. Zeik 
3. Dyolph 
4. ipco
1. Barkaya

Congratulations!

The winners have all been contacted via private message on Steam which includes their Ponpu Launch key! If any of the 5 winners did not yet receive a key, make sure to contact us at zp@zordix.com

Keep an eye out for future community competition, here on Steam or through Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ponpugame/

We want to thank you for taking part in this community event and hope to see you soon, on the battlefield of egg-splosions!

[h2]The 5 winners[/h2]
Out of all people who vote in this contest we will randomly select 5 winners who will all receive a Ponpu Gamekey that will allow them to activate Ponpu in their game library here on Steam, which will allow the player to access the game on launch.

[h2]Winning announcement[/h2]
The winning community pick for this vote will be announced here on Ponpu's Steam community forum on [b]the 1st of September 2020[/b]. The video of the chosen featured gamemode will be displayed in an announcement post along with the names of the 5 winners, we will also reach out to these 5 winners through Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37336806/a8bc0a3fd63535a8728894e44d7c8b5082810bfa.png[/img]

[h2]Voting instructions:[/h2]
In order to vote in this election and enter the competition, simply comment bellow on this announcement post. For example, if you would like to vote for alternative "3. Deathmatch", then your comment would be: "3. Deathmatch". Short and simple!

Vote for the gamemode that you want to see more video gameplay of!

Bombs on and may the best duck not explode!
